course_name_en: Basic Figure Training of Folk Dances

learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn the history of folk dances.
Students will acquire basic skills in folk dance figures.
Students will acquire the traditional and characteristic features of folk dances and will be able to pass them on to future generations.
Students will acquire general game knowledge and skills.
Students will learn through interdisciplinary teaching and cooperation, and will recognize the basic principles and application areas in sports.

syllabus_topics: Definition of folklore, history and types of folk dances, general information
Basic figures of Halay region dances
Basic figures of Zeybek region dances
Basic figures of Karşılama region dances
Basic figures of Horon region dances
Basic figures of Spoon dances (Kaşıkla oynanan) region
General local clothing information of the taught regions
Teaching of the music of the dances of the taught regions
